spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Mobile-first grids. Material Design 3 soft corners.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Bento grid for projects. Asymmetric card layouts for experience.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards: scale up by 1.02, elevate shadow (MD3 shadow-lg). Buttons: brightness up or simulated ripple.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), hover states must increase contrast.

components.buttons: Shadcn UI customized for full rounded corners (rounded-full). Primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground.
components.cards: bg-[#1E1E1E] rounded-3xl p-6 or p-8. No border or very subtle border-white/5.
components.navbar: Floating pill nav: fixed top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-[#282828]/80 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-full px-6 py-3 z-50 shadow-lg.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the exact colors specified in the 'colors' block. Map them effectively to MD3 semantic concepts.
Build a single-page portfolio with smooth scrolling navigation.

Implement Google Material Design 3 aesthetics: Use 'rounded-3xl' for big cards, and 'rounded-full' for floating headers and primary buttons. Incorporate elevation via background lightness (background -> surface -> surface_container).
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Roboto' for body text (import via Google Fonts).
Sections required: Hero, About, Skills, Projects, Experience Timeline, Contact.
Projects section should be split visually or via tabs into 'Dev Projects' and '3D Printing'. Use the media array images for placeholder cards.
Experience Timeline should showcase 12+ years of corporate and freelance history.
Contact section must clearly highlight the email 'skr@zasdevlabs.tech' and website 'zasdevlabs.tech'.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs if any) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-email-link').
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide React for professional iconography.
No auth required. Focus strictly on visual presentation and mobile responsiveness.
